applicant.name: Mag. Andrea Kainz
applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Health, department for quality in healthcare

purpose: Guidelines recommend beta blockers for most patients with heart failure. We want to know how large the treatment gap is, to plan a quality programme.
question: Among adults with heart failure, how many have no active beta blocker, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Beta blocker = ATC code starting with C07.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per age band: adults with heart failure, how many of them have no active beta blocker and that share in %, one decimal.
